failed_hard_gates.evidence: Both primary hand-rail grips, both hinge attachments, flat taped paper and the screen-paper opening are visible. However the classmate’s fingertip is extremely close to the paper and its required above-paper air gap cannot be distinguished in the original or unresampled crop. This missing relation cannot pass and is not a diagnosis of finger deformation.

The oblique frame gives useful area to the main face, grips, hinges and print mechanism. However the classmate fingertip-to-paper air gap remains indistinguishable, and the camera-near/left outer paper boundary reaches the lower frame edge, leaving the complete sheet criterion unproven. Thus the complete critical relationship set is only partially assessable. The initial separate testcase report is preserved with a B12 correction in pixel_review_addendum.json.

user_judgment.evidence: No requesting-user artistic preference or acceptance has been received; the reference portrait is an appearance input, not a prior same-scene generated baseline.

visual.boundary: This audit validates recorded pixel-review evidence and, when applicable, user acceptance; it does not infer visual truth from metadata, authenticate who authored a review, or declare moe on the user's behalf.
